The '''VX-5 Ricker''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that saw use throughout the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The ship had a rectangular body with a a triangular underside and triangular cockpit, and two wings at the rear of the ship that were angled up and away from the body. It was produced by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]].<ref name="Showroom">{{TORcite|type=location|[[Seario Memorial Showroom]]|[[CZ-198]]}}</ref>

==History==
The [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] scoundrel [[Gault Rennow]] used a VX-5 Ricker during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]];<ref name="TOR:ASE">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Catching A Slippery Eel|Tatooine}}</ref> until the ship was shot down by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Veeboo Lunx]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="TOR:CV">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Confronting Veeboo|Tatooine}}</ref> and crashed in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]].<ref name="TOR:ASE" />

During the [[Showdown on Ruhnuk]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] of [[Mandalorian Trat'ade|Mandalore the Avenger's faction]] used VX-5 Rickers to deploy troops on the [[Reconstructed Combat Arena|base]] of the splinter faction [[Hidden Chain]].<ref name="TOR:SoR" />
